## 1.1.2 — 2026-08-12

### Drive Cut Valet with your own AI (MCP)
- **Connect Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or any MCP agent** — one toggle in
  Settings, one pasted command, and your own AI assistant can browse your
  footage (transcripts, semantic search, factual filters by date/time/
  quality), see the playhead, cut timelines clip by clip on any track,
  apply speed ramps, and build full rough cuts — on your existing AI
  subscription, no API key. Off by default; localhost-only; ingest,
  settings, and your keys are never exposed.
- **One "How Cut Valet thinks" setting** — Private (built in) / Your AI
  agent / Cloud API — replaces the scattered AI provider controls.
  Transcription, search, and descriptions always run on your computer,
  whichever you pick.

### Fixes that matter
- **High-frame-rate footage cuts at the right moment.** 60/120fps clips in
  AI rough cuts landed at the wrong point in the clip (a 120fps cut showed
  a moment 5× earlier than intended); frame conversion now uses each
  clip's own measured rate. Out-of-range cuts also clamp visibly instead
  of leaving single-frame black gaps.
- **First-run fixes:** the AI chat panel works out of the box on the
  built-in local AI (it previously demanded an API key that the local
  engine doesn't need); custom graphics no longer require a Claude key
  specifically; the same footage no longer appears twice in AI plans after
  a re-ingest to a second drive.
- **Resolve connection diagnostics** now capture the installed Resolve
  version and your security software automatically, so connection issues
  are diagnosable from one report.
- RED/Blackmagic/ARRI/Canon cinema formats: sidecar files (.rmd, .sidecar,
  .aml) stay with the footage; Canon Cinema RAW Light (.crm) is recognized
  everywhere; R3D clips get browser previews from their embedded stills.
- Mapped network drives: previews and archive write-back work on projects
  stored at a drive letter mapped to a NAS.
